title: gator-preferences-v1
description: The unified machine-local preferences file (~/.gator/preferences.json). Machine-scoped execution reality that must NOT live in repo-scoped .gator/: which Python launcher/interpreter to use, and (reserved for a follow-on plan) local hook-mode overrides. Additive within v1 — every field and every top-level section is optional; unknown sections and fields are tolerated for forward-compat. A machine may have this file with only a `python:` section, only a (future) `hooks:` section, or both. Under the resolver's shebang path (v2.10.0+), a malformed preferences file must be surfaced as a loud degradation, never silently ignored — otherwise a user-declared override collapses back to auto-detect and the recovery UX is defeated.

schema.description: Schema tag. Readers MUST check this before interpreting other fields.

updated_at.description: UTC timestamp of last write (ISO 8601, seconds precision, Z suffix). Writer stamps; reader ignores. Aids field debugging.

python.description: Machine-local Python launcher/interpreter preferences. All fields optional; absent section means 'no launcher preference set'.

source.description: How the current value was recorded. `user` = edited by hand or via `gator prefs set-python-launcher`. `repair-command` = written by a future auto-materialization verb. Unknown values are tolerated (forward-compat).

windows_py_launcher.description: Absolute, spaceless path to a Windows Python Launcher (`py.exe`). Load-bearing for git-hook shebang generation on Windows. Forward-slash normalized on write; validator re-checks on read (existence, basename `py.exe`, absolute, spaceless — POSIX shebang cannot quote paths with spaces).

allow_for_hook_shebang.description: When false, the configured launcher is not used for hook-shebang generation even if otherwise valid. Reserved for the future case where a launcher is a valid interpreter but not shebang-safe. Defaults to true when omitted.

hooks.description: RESERVED for the hook-mode follow-on plan (Sketch B §6/§10). The launcher-preference implementation (v2.10.0) does not read or write anything under this section. Documented in the schema so the file layout is stable before the follow-on plan starts.

notes.description: Free-form operator note; ignored by code.
